In Islamic context, Akhter can refer to the one who is closest to Allah or the one who is dearest to the heart. The name Akhter carries the meaning “The Nearest One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akhter usually hope their child will grow to embody the nearest one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أختَر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني النجم الفاتح، الممتاز، الأول، الأفضل، و هو لقب لمراتب اجتماعية
